steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ with login 'admin' and password 'admin' (skip if already signed in). Then create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Use the Sales or Contacts app to create it. Verify afterwards that the customer record exists and shows City = Benchville, and report the customer's display name and city as shown on the page.

02-create: In Odoo (already signed in as admin), create a new Quotation in the Sales app for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose the customer from the autocomplete dropdown — typing alone does not count). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue using the product autocomplete dropdown, and set the quantity to 3. Do NOT confirm the quotation yet — leave it as a draft quotation. Then report: (a) the exact product name you chose, (b) the unit price the app auto-filled for that line, (c) the untaxed amount the app computes for the order, and (d) the quotation's reference/name shown on the page.

03-open: In Odoo (signed in as admin), open the existing draft quotation with reference {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (find it in the Sales app's Quotations list). Add a SECOND order line to it: a DIFFERENT product from the existing line '{{02-create.product_name}}' — pick the second product from the product autocomplete dropdown — with quantity 2. Keep the existing first line unchanged (product Acoustic Bloc Screens, quantity 3). Save the quotation but do NOT confirm it. Then report: (a) the exact name of the second product you added, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new untaxed amount the app computes for the whole order.

04-open: In Odoo (signed in as admin), open the existing draft quotation with reference {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer'. Change the FIRST order line's quantity from 3 to 5 — the first line is the one with product '{{02-create.product_name}}'. Leave the second line ('{{03-open.line2_product}}', quantity 2) unchanged. Save the quotation but do NOT confirm it. Then report: (a) the quantity now shown on the first line, (b) the quantity shown on the second line, and (c) the new untaxed amount the app computes for the whole order.
